scope: Two Kaggle T4 resource-profile jobs only; original profile source/recipe unchanged.
reason: Existing sealed runner admits one or two measured T4 devices when actual host memory/CPU reservations fit. Metadata machine-shape alone does not prove a single device.
concurrency_rule: Use unchanged runner admit_specs on measured inventory; record admitted concurrency and per-job devices/host limits.
interpretation: Profile training rates condition on actual concurrency/host contention. Preserve startup versus steady training phases; do not label parallel profiles serial. No paid capacity/top-up.
